title: Newton diaries: Sarbacher tells Wilbur Smith UFOs are top secret

tellings.quote: And and uh Silus Newton in his diaries would talk about Wilbur B. Smith, Canadian radio engineer who spearheaded Canada's first uh project on UFOs who was told by Robert Sarbacher,

And during this meeting, Robert Sarbacher said stuff like, well, in the n, you know, 1950, there were meetings about flying saucers. Uh, the US government studies them. It's spearheaded by a group of Vanavar Bush.
tellings.difference: Sources it to the 1950 Canadian Department of Transport memo and The Flying Saucer Conspiracy rather than Silas Newton's diaries, and mentions Frank Scully.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Robert Sarbacher telling Wilbert Smith in 1950 that the US studies saucers in secret under a group led by Vannevar Bush.

as_told.title: Sarbacher tells Wilbert Smith that saucers are studied under Vannevar Bush

plain: In 1950, a man named Robert Sarbacher is said to have told Wilbert B. Smith, a Canadian radio engineer who led Canada's first government project on UFOs, that flying saucers were real, top secret, and studied by the US government through a group led by a man named Vannevar Bush. A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb tells this twice, summarising without naming a single direct source. In one telling he says it comes from the diaries of a man named Silas Newton, and in the other from a 1950 memo of Canada's Department of Transport and a book called The Flying Saucer Conspiracy, also mentioning a writer named Frank Scully.
